route_limit: OPR-C is the third and final OPRV3 detector route; no OPR-D/E/F is authorized.

prior_failures.OPR_A: The class-agnostic small-object specialist passed proposal recall, but the bounded closed-set classifier adaptations could not simultaneously preserve cross-domain recall and background specificity.
prior_failures.OPR_B: Faster R-CNN R50-FPN-v2 with explicit 8/12/16-pixel P2 anchors passed holdout recall/precision but fell to 0.810855 correct-class recall on isolated VAL; bottle and metal-can recall were 0.772277 and 0.673171 while precision and negative FP passed.

selected_official_detector.name: RTMDet-s
selected_official_detector.checkpoint_provenance: Official MMDetection RTMDet model-zoo link for the v3.3.0 config; redistribution remains subject to the upstream notice and local third-party audit.

architecture_hypothesis.targeted_failure: cross-world bottle and metal-can appearance generalization at small native scale
architecture_hypothesis.mechanism: RTMDet-s directly learns the three closed classes with an anchor-free dense head, CSPNeXt plus PA-FPN multi-scale features, and dynamic soft-label assignment. COCO-pretrained features provide an independent initialization from the failed Torchvision two-stage route.
architecture_hypothesis.falsification_gate: Use TRAIN-world selection only, then require isolated G6 VAL recall >=0.95, precision >=0.95, unmatched background FP/frame <=0.05, and each-class recall >=0.90 without reading G5_SEALED_FINAL. G6 contains negative-area backgrounds but no full-frame discrete-negative VAL images, so a zero-denominator pure-negative metric is reported but never used as a pass gate.

expected_inference_cost.note: Official benchmark is architecture-selection context, not local product acceptance; local end-to-end P95 must be measured later.

j6_path: If OPR-C passes x86 development, distill its three-class outputs into a fixed-input MobileNetV3/ResNet18-level J6 student; no claim of current J6 operator compatibility is made.
